message.content:
The largest planet currently known in the universe is **HD 100546 b**.  
It is an exoplanet orbiting the young B-type star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 times that of Jupiter** (about 18,000 km). Its mass is still uncertain, but its size makes it the biggest planet discovered so far.
